user_query: I'm organizing a family gathering and I want to create a playlist with popular adult pop songs. Can you provide me with the top 10 songs on the Adult Pop Songs Artists chart? Additionally, suggest some albums by these artists that I can include in the playlist.

TaskList.description: Retrieve the top 10 songs from the Adult Pop Songs Artists chart.
Retrieve albums by the top 10 Adult Pop Songs Artists for inclusion in the playlist.
